description: 土壤液化潛勢圖資群組 [earthquakes and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. 本資料集為土壤液化潛勢圖，三星級政府開放資料,由線上直接介接或下載另存新檔使用，格式符合ISO16262標準，下載檔案格式為JSON，同時亦支援其子集GeoJSON。 本資料集之土壤液化潛勢圖為比例尺1:25,000之「初級」精度調查研究成果，做為國土規劃或其它更精細調查研究之基礎資料，惟請勿用於個案工程規劃設計，如有建築開發需求，應依相... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-08-08 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
